title.script: Can you teach a computer to keep score? Today, you will use Python to investigate a small question about practice shots. You will make a prediction, test it with code, and explain what the result means. AI can help you think and build, but you will make the decisions and check the evidence. Our practice data is invented for learning, so no personal sports records are needed.
